title: Smoke/fuel-leak hazard escalates to a human with safety guidance

caller_answers.incident_description: Crash with smoke from the hood and a suspected fuel leak.

dashboard_summary: Safety escalation (hazard) - connect caller to a human immediately.
demo_notes: Deterministic hazard escalation (fire/smoke/fuel). Run via simulate_birchwood_call.py scenario hazard_fire_escalate.
provisional_note: PROVISIONAL - confirm hazard trigger list and ESCALATE_SAFETY handling with Birchwood (July discovery call).
flow_note: Safety hardening: hazard/scene/legal route to ESCALATE_SAFETY before routine intake gates; over-escalation preferred.

flow_note: Safety hardening: legal-sensitive situations get an immediate human handoff; the bot never advises on fault/liability.
